name: STAR Time — Julian and Besselian epochs
summary: Julian and Besselian epochs to and from two-part Julian Dates; agrees with ERFA to 5e-13 yr, with skyfield and five SPICE constants to 3e-10 day on 600 dates and 600 epochs, and refuses out-of-range input.
reference: Lieske 1979 / Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, ch. 21: B1950.0 = JD 2433282.4235
reference_observed: JD 2433282.42345905, within 4.1e-5 day of the printed value (printed to 1e-4)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: epochs in years, dates as two-part Julian Dates in days; output ranges stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; no iteration
